rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 7 "Take stock of the box": line 120: "The bet is written against it next" is the closest: "the bet" is not named earlier in the file; it is a forward pointer in a closer (module-arc closer carve-out), and the harm (a reader stuck on an unresolved referent) is absent because the sentence names the next step, not a claim that depends on it. Every other referent resolves in-file: line 108 "the Phase 1 baseline", line 104 "the two quotes" -> line 104 two lines, line 116 "five boxes" -> Phases 1-5.

line 120: "on Day 3 five people from outside the team look at it" names the event by claim, not by file position; no "the opening lecture said" shape. grep -nEi 'lecture|earlier file|opening' in body: only maintainer block.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 108 "the Phase 1 baseline" resolves to chunk 1 "Phase 1: The boring baseline"; line 116 "Same model, five boxes" resolves to the passes of Phases 1-5; line 110 "Phase 6" fresh read in-file. No "the X you did" pointing outside the file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 46: "Open the page. It works. It reads like a box." is the closest, a verbed reveal with no guess-cue before or after it; line 108 "You told Claude different things between the two, and nothing else changed" is a stated observation, not a guess beat. No predict instruction anywhere, so reveal-before-guess cannot occur; every sentence is verbed so the muted read has a scene.

smallest chunks: chunk 7 "Take stock of the box" (87 words) and chunk 5 "Phase 5: Make it yours" (89 words, line 94 "Iterate until the three of you would put it on the table in a customer meeting"); each carries an instruction and a stop condition, so none is a wait-state.

chunk 3 "Phase 3: What only your product does" lines 70-76: content is exactly the only-us stickies and the repaint, header literally true; chunk 6 "Phase 6: A fresh read" lines 102-110: closest, the header says read while the slide also adds a push-back, which is still the read's outcome.

line 46 "It works. It reads like a box. It is also a box your nearest competitor could print" is the closest to an anaphora triple; the third leg carries new concrete content. line 82 "Not categories (...) but the real complaint" is a single not-X-but-Y, not the banned Not X. Not Y. Z. grep -nE 'most useful|one of the' body: 0 superlatives; no number-plus-retraction; no empty verb triplets.
